fields.statement: At 41d1705de re-ran the Checks: block: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestSessionBrief (TestSessionBrief and TestSessionBriefUnwritable PASS), go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/brief-files$' (ok), every script reading .git/rhiza/runs via the grep-built regex (ok, 358s, so the attempt-1 run-nested-workflow-session failure is fixed), rhiza ship generate and rhiza render (exit 0); also TestSessionRun/TestStartCheck/TestStartFix and internal/session (ok). Diff read: prepareSession wired into StartAgent, StartLeaf (builder/verifier incl. fix cycles), StartCheck and StartFix; slice.json is canon-marshalled runSlice output, which the test compares to rhiza slice --json; launchEnv sets RHIZA_BRIEF/RHIZA_SLICE only with a Brief dir and RHIZA_HANDBACK only when handback.md exists, and unsets all three outside a run; the unwritable runs path fails the start naming the path, with no rex call and no agent (unit test and brief-files.txtar). Prompt rendering and the workflow format are unchanged; no TODOs or stubs. Extra files (session.go request field, session.Record.Brief, session_test unset lists) are needed plumbing.
